description: MC + brain read probe: mc_self_check, mc_get_context, mc_search_knowledge (MC read tools via tools/call, operator cos@petrasoap.com unless MC_OPERATOR_EMAIL is set) and brain agent/status; counts and shapes only.
notes: Enabled: the runner may run the read-only MC MCP tools/call steps; each appends an mcp.tool.invoked audit row in MC, which the owner accepted. Only the three read tools in integrations.mc_brain_probe.PROBE_TOOLS are callable (the probe client refuses any other name and every write before I/O; plx_hub_guard refuses MC write tools as well). MC write tools stay forbidden. MC_OPERATOR_EMAIL wins when set; otherwise the documented agent operator alias is used, as in mc.initialize_tools_list; the report names only operator_email_source, never the value. Live-unverified until the live check records a result; module tests are injected-transport (integrations/tests/test_mc_brain_guard.py ProbeTests, integrations/tests/test_mc_brain_probe_scope.py). A failed step carries the sanitized UpstreamError diagnosis: layer (transport, http, jsonrpc, tool, knowledge_status), http_status, rpc_code (JSON-RPC integer), upstream_code (lowercase identifier only), cause_class and attempts; never a message or body. layer knowledge_status with error upstream_error means MC answered 200 and its own brain call failed (non-2xx or non-JSON; MC does not pass the brain status on), so compare the brain agent/status step. Diagnosis is injected-transport tested (integrations/tests/test_mc_brain_guard.py ProbeTests); live-unverified until the live check records a result. Blocked, not failed: when mc_search_knowledge still reports knowledge_status upstream_error/upstream_unreachable after MC-side retries (MC's own brain relay failed; observed intermittently 2026-10-02 07:05Z, 2026-10-03 07:34Z, 2026-10-05 15:03Z while vmc.knowledge_search and brain agent/status passed in the same runs) the probe runs one brain GET agent/search with the same query over the configured pair; knowledge.fallback records not_needed, answered, failed or not_run. If it answers, knowledge.served_by is brain_fallback and the MC step is listed in blocked_upstream (cause upstream_outage). If it fails with an upstream answer too (e.g. 503), served_by stays null and blocked_upstream lists the MC step (http_status 200, upstream_error), brain:agent/search and, when it failed the same way, brain:agent/status, each with its http_status and code: the brain itself is out. Either way expect_blocked applies (it requires ok, not served_by): the check is blocked, never pass, red after 24 h. Any other failure (guard refusal, malformed answer, another MC failure) stays a fail. brain.credential_pair names the configured host/key pair (brain or vmc-fallback), never what served the answer. A brain step refused with 401/403 (error auth_refused: the key is refused) is not an outage (decision 2026-10-07-brain-fallback-refused-key): it is never listed in blocked_upstream, so the check is a fail, while the MC step stays blocked as upstream_outage. causes is the headline: each blocked step with its cause and each refused step as credential_refused, in step order. A malformed answer the client accepted but the probe cannot summarize is a failed step (error malformed_answer), never a crash.
